title: LLM4Rec: Large Language Models for Multimodal Generative Recommendation with Causal Debiasing

bias_targets.methodology: Using inverse propensity scoring to adjust for non-random user-item interactions within the dataset.
Employing structural causal models and do-calculus to estimate the causal effect of item features on user preference independent of item popularity.
Implementing adversarial debiasing with fairness constraints to enforce demographic parity, evaluated using category-based fairness metrics.
